objective: Prove the reduction (R) of the frozen statement: a row-linear polynomial of bit LeftPigeon derived in PC degree B, with 2lB - 1 <= n, lies in the kernel K_k of the reduced decoder modulo Braun's unary ideal; and bound K_k as far as a proof allows.
status: Proved 2026-11-10: for bit LeftPigeon with 2lB - 1 <= n, a row-linear polynomial derived in PC degree B lies in the kernel of the reduced decoder modulo Braun's unary degree-k ideal (Lemma 1, Braun's decoder transfer and stability), so separation is a static question; the (l+1)^2 inverse-counting identities lie in the kernel.
title: Separation through the decoder's kernel
